item.title: Golden Petals, Poetic Roots: Punjab Gul-e-Sahir Chrysanthemum Debuts at PAU
item.description: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana, blooms with a flower that carries both beauty and legacy: the chrysanthemum variety named Punjab Gul-e-Sahir. It is officially released in 2025; this vibrant mustard-yellow blossom is a heartfelt tribute to the lyrical heritage of poet Sahir Ludhianvi, with its name meaning “Flower of Sahir”.

item.title: CM Bhagwant Mann Hands Over Appointment Letters to Youths in Punjab Power Corporations
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann handed over appointment letters to 2,105 young people recruited in the Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) and the Punjab State Transmission Corporation Limited (PSTCL), bringing the total number of government jobs given to youth so far to 58,962, according to an official press release.

item.title: Punjab Govt Invites Baba Gurinder Singh Dhillon For The 350th Martyrdom Anniversary Of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib Ji
item.description: Punjab Education Minister Harjot Singh Bains and Advisor to Tourism and Cultural Affairs Department Mr. Deepak Bali extended an invitation to Baba Gurinder Singh Dhillon for the 350th Martyrdom Anniversary of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib Ji, an official press release said.

item.title: Punjab Police Nabs Man Accused of Stealing De-Addiction Medicines from Moga Civil Hospital; Hundreds of Tablets Already Sold
item.description: The Punjab Police has arrested a person allegedly involved in the theft of de-addiction medicines from the Moga Civil Hospital, according to an official release quoting Health and Family Welfare Minister Dr. Balbir Singh.

item.description: Punjab Education Minister Harjot Singh Bains, along with Advisor to the Tourism & Cultural Affairs Department Deepak Bali, on Monday called on Giani Kuldeep Singh Garjgajj, Officiating Jathedar of Sri Akal Takht Sahib and Jathedar of Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib, according to an official release.
